services.name: fly fishing
services.desc: I always wonder why saltwater fly fishermen get caught up in Choosing Fly Patterns and Colors at the Dock, instead of on the water. I see it all the time with clients who come fishing with me for the first time. They are putting their fly rod together and ask Captain what color fly today? My response is let’s wait until we get to the area we are going to fish and see what our conditions are at that point. You should see their face of disbelief and total disappointment. My office is the Louisiana Delta out of Venice, Louisiana, which changes on a daily basis from location, depth, water clarity, and what species from Redfish, Sharks, Jacks, Tarpon, Tuna, or anything else that is swimming
